name: Win 4 Fighter (W4F)
author: Kris Dabrowski
description: A minimalist fighting game based on the core of Virtua Fighter, meant for two players: punch, guard, crouch and throw. Press punch and guard together to throw.

descriptions.en: A minimalist fighting game based on the core of Virtua Fighter, meant for two players: punch, guard, crouch and throw. Press punch and guard together to throw.
descriptions.it: Un picchiaduro minimalista basato sul cuore di Virtua Fighter, pensato per due giocatori: pugni, guardia, accovacciate e prese. Pugno e guardia insieme per la presa.
